2.w: “How long until you make an end of words? You must consider, and then we can talk.

3.w: Why should we be regarded as beasts, and considered stupid in your sight?

4.w: You who tear yourself to pieces in your anger, will the earth be abandoned for your sake? Or will a rock be moved from its place?

5.w: “Yes, the lamp of the wicked is extinguished; his flame of fire does not shine.

6.w: The light in his tent grows dark; his lamp above him is extinguished.

7.w: His vigorous steps are restricted, and his own counsel throws him down.

8.w: For he has been thrown into a net by his feet, and he wanders into a mesh.

9.w: A trap seizes him by the heel; a snare grips him.

10.w: A rope is hidden for him on the ground, and a trap for him lies on the path.

11.w: Terrors frighten him on all sides and dog his every step.

12.w: Calamity is hungry for him, and misfortune is ready at his side.

13.w: It eats away parts of his skin; the most terrible death devours his limbs.

14.w: He is dragged from the security of his tent, and marched off to the king of terrors.

15.w: Fire resides in his tent; over his residence burning sulfur is scattered.

16.w: Below his roots dry up, and his branches wither above.

17.w: His memory perishes from the earth he has no name in the land.

18.w: He is driven from light into darkness and is banished from the world.

19.w: He has neither children nor descendants among his people, no survivor in those places he once stayed.

20.w: People of the west are appalled at his fate; people of the east are seized with horror, saying,

21.w: ‘Surely such is the residence of an evil man; and this is the place of one who has not known God.’”
